messages:
Maria G: quick heads up — i'm wiring a new `reengage` tag + automated touch playbook for churn-risk accounts. starting with the csv enrichment import path. seeing duplicate follow-ups for a handful of accounts. anyone else?
Dom R: saw the same on staging this morning, ~8 accounts got 2x emails in 10s.
Kevin H: do we know if the CSV importer emitted duplicate webhook events or if playbook executed twice?
Lina O: initial glance — importer retries on 5xx, but we also have the enrichment job that fanouts two events (contact_enriched + account_enriched). playbook listens on account_enriched.
Maria G: repro log snip:
```
INFO 2026-03-15 09:12:03 import_service: emitted event request_id=abc123 account_id=ACCT-778
INFO 2026-03-15 09:12:04 import_service: retry emit request_id=abc123 status=200
INFO 2026-03-15 09:12:06 playbook-runner: received webhook payload {"account_id":"ACCT-778","request_id":"abc123"}
INFO 2026-03-15 09:12:07 playbook-runner: received webhook payload {"account_id":"ACCT-778","request_id":"abc123"}
```
Kevin H: ah looks like duplicate emit with same request_id but no idempotency check in playbook. we should dedupe on request_id in the runner.
Dom R: agreed. also we should gate reengage by `last_contacted` to avoid spamming. maybe only enqueue if last_contacted > 30d.
Lina O: +1. quick mitigation: add a short in-memory dedupe cache keyed by `request_id` for 1m and persist a seen_requests table for 24h. low-effort and safe.
playbook-bot: NOTE: playbook "reengage_touch" currently has `on_event: account_enriched` and `retry: 3`. Suggested change: set `retry: 0` for importer-path events and rely on importer idempotency.
Maria G: proposed action items: 1) add idempotency check in playbook-runner (request_id) — dom + kevin to pair, 2) add `last_contacted` gate in playbook filters (lina to add config), 3) dry-run the updated playbook on a small sample, 4) monitor for dup emails for 24h.
Kevin H: I'll open the PR for runner dedupe, will include tests.
Dom R: i'll coordinate the deploy window (low traffic: 10pm PST) and add DB migration for seen_requests table.
Lina O: adding gating config now, will push to staging and tag @Maria G when ready.
Maria G: thanks — if we can ship the mitigation today we can avoid rolling back the import. ping me if you need sample account ids (i'll DM). :thumbsup:
playbook-bot: deployment scheduled: playbook-runner patch -> canary at 22:00 PST.
Maria G: perfect — follow-up in morning to confirm green.
